summary: Iteration 55 — Featured Tip Rotation + Weekly Digest Schedule (APScheduler) + Toggle + Unsubscribe. Full backend (9/9 pytest) and frontend (home strip + admin digest strip) verified end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1308 lines — still recommend splitting community/digest/parse into a `community` sub-router for maintainability (raised in iter54 too).

APScheduler creates a fresh AsyncIOScheduler on every FastAPI startup event; the double-register in logs (00:14:11 and 00:14:21) suggests startup runs twice (likely reload). Confirm production has reload disabled or guard with `if _scheduler is None` (currently only guards `.running`, so a shutdown/restart cycle is safe).

unsubscribe endpoint is declared with `response_class=FileResponse` but returns an `HTMLResponse` — cosmetic mismatch, works because FastAPI honours the actual response object, but the OpenAPI schema is misleading. Change to `HTMLResponse`.
test_credentials: ADMIN_TOKEN=[REDACTED_ADMIN_TOKEN] (from /app/backend/.env). Admin UI unlock: localStorage.setItem('irr.admin_token', <token>) then load /admin/community.
seed_data_creation: Test tip 'TEST_iter55 seed featured' inserted + promoted + deleted (cleaned up via DELETE /api/community/tips/{id}). Anonymous-submit regression test also cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file `test_featured_and_scheduler.py` is idempotent and safe to re-run. It relies on env vars from frontend/.env (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL) and backend/.env (MONGO_URL, DB_NAME) — export them before running pytest, e.g. `export $(grep -v '^#' frontend/.env backend/.env | xargs)`. There are already 2 promoted tips in prod DB seed; featured endpoint deterministically picks by `date.toordinal() % len(docs)`. The FirstRunTour + QuickGuideModal auto-open on Home block clicks — pre-set localStorage keys 'irr.firstRunTourDone' / 'irr.quickGuideSeen' before testing FeaturedTipStrip.

verified_flows.backend_featured: Public GET works no-auth, returns {tip,total_promoted}. Two consecutive calls return same tip.id (deterministic same-day).
verified_flows.backend_digest_status_auth: Missing X-Admin-Token → 401; with token → 200 with all 6 fields incl. scheduler_next_run == next Monday 09:00 UTC (verified weekday=0 hour=9 minute=0).
verified_flows.backend_digest_toggle: POST enabled:false → /digest/send returns {ok:false, reason:'digest disabled (unsubscribed)'}. Toggle back on → /digest/send returns {ok:false, reason:'RESEND_API_KEY not configured on server'}.
verified_flows.backend_unsubscribe: Wrong token → HTML 'Link expired'. Correct token (fetched from mongo app_config.digest.unsubscribe_token) → HTML 'You are unsubscribed' AND status.enabled flips to false. Re-toggled on for cleanup.
verified_flows.backend_scheduler_logs: 'weekly_digest scheduler started (Mon 09:00 UTC)' present in backend.err.log.
verified_flows.frontend_featured_strip: Renders above notes list with heading 'Batch cook rice' + body + 'Open guide' + dismiss X. Dismiss sets localStorage['irr.featured_tip_hidden_date']='2026-08-07' and hides strip immediately.
verified_flows.frontend_admin_digest: digest-status-strip shows 'Weekly digest ON · Next: Mon, Aug 10, 09:00 AM · Never sent · RESEND_API_KEY missing'. Toggle button flips label ON↔OFF and updates strip text ('Weekly digest OFF (unsubscribed)') + toast 'Weekly digest turned ON/OFF'.
